title: Keyturn Vehicle Listing Classes: Document Notice, Verification and Registration Grace
content:
Every Keyturn Vehicle Listing depends on documents that expire, and three periods govern them: how long before expiry the host is warned, how long the marketplace takes to verify a document it has received, and how long a listing may stay live past the expiry of its registration.

| Class | Warning before a document expires (calendar days) | Verification period (business days) | Registration grace (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 30 | 3 | 10 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 30 | 3 | 10 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 45 | 2 | 7 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 60 | 2 | 5 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 90 | 1 | 0 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 45 | 3 | 7 |

The three columns run on different clocks and are not interchangeable. The warning period and the registration grace are counted in whole calendar days; the verification period is counted in business days. A Keyturn Exotic Class Listing carries the longest warning of the six, 90 calendar days, and no registration grace at all, its grace figure standing at 0 calendar days; a Keyturn Economy Class Listing is warned 30 calendar days ahead and may stand 10 calendar days past registration expiry.
